svg.title: AsOf
svg.desc: Checks an AI assistant's answer against the policy that was in force on the customer's date. Built on IBM Db2. The same draft is corrected for 10 March 2026, when policy BRV-002 v1 was in force, and released for 2 June 2026 under BRV-002 v2. 1,331 tests. 0 of 65 wrong drafts released on blind sets.
